meta.name: hyperframes-registry
meta.description: Install, discover, and wire registry blocks and components into HyperFrames compositions. Use when running hyperframes add or hyperframes catalog, installing one item or every block matching a tag, wiring an installed item into index.html, or working with hyperframes.json. Covers discovery, install locations, block sub-composition wiring, component snippet merging, and authoring a new block or component to contribute upstream (idea → scaffold → validate → PR).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发现、安装并接入页面组件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在用 HyperFrames 搭建页面，想复用现成块或贡献新块。
copy.tagline_en: Discover, install, and wire page components
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build pages with HyperFrames and want to reuse or contribute components.

howto.what: 装了这个技能，Claude 就能安装、查找 HyperFrames 的块与组件，把它们接进项目里的 index.html，也能新建块或组件提交给上游。
howto.when: 当你要用 hyperframes add/catalog 安装或搜索块/组件、把装好的部件接进 index.html，或改 hyperframes.json 时触发。

say.text: 帮我安装 data-chart 这个块。
搜一个能逐行揭示标题的效果。
say.note: 会按英文查询检索 catalog，返回相关度排序的候选。

say.text: 把 grain-overlay 组件接进我的主合成。
say.note: 会读取组件文件并把 HTML/CSS/JS 并入主合成。

howto.what_en: Can install and search HyperFrames registry blocks and components, wire them into a project's index.html, and create new blocks or components to contribute upstream.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to use hyperframes add/catalog to install or search blocks/components, wire an installed item into index.html, or edit hyperframes.json.

say_en.text: Install the data-chart block for me.
say_en.note: Runs add and tells you which attributes to fill in.

say_en.text: Search for an effect that reveals a headline one line at a time.
say_en.note: Queries the catalog in English and returns ranked matches.
Merges its HTML/CSS/JS into the host composition.
